reason: I already take Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, and it costs less per box. $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer, so I have no reason to switch.
objection: It costs more than what I already buy and I have no proof it works better for me. The lab report is nice, but I'm not going to pay extra for it.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or below what I pay for Toplux, or a free first box so I can try it without risk.
